acceptanceCriteria: A reviewer's full findings survive the runner boundary as retained evidence, never truncated into a transport field
The vendor CLI is no longer required to emit a rigid envelope; a job whose CLI writes only prose and files still yields a correct structured result
The managing agent reports what the runner said and never judges the work itself; it has no authority to accept
A verdict is traceable: the agent quotes the reviewer's own supporting words, stored with the result, and an unsupported verdict is a runner failure rather than an acceptance
An undetermined verdict withholds acceptance instead of defaulting to accept
The raw transcript and every file the vendor CLI wrote are retained as job artifacts, so any interpretation can be audited afterwards
The managing agent runs read-only for reviewer jobs and cannot mutate task state, campaign state, or the repository
All nine configured profiles pass a real-CLI gate asserting that verdict and findings survive interpretation
deliverables: Managing-agent result contract: its returned schema, system brief, and read-only posture, tested against recorded real transcripts rather than fakes
A result-interpretation seam on RunnerPort, with today's schema path as one implementation so the change stays bisectable
The agent interpreter: spawn, structured output, evidence retention, indeterminate handling
Verdict plumbing above the runner boundary: provenance reason, supervisor coverage of a revise verdict, fail-closed acceptance
Retirement of the brief-stated envelope contracts and the fake-runner mimicry they forced, once the agent path carries real traffic
Real-CLI probe extended to assert verdict and findings survive interpretation across every profile
title: Managing-agent runner layer so the CLI need not emit a rigid envelope
verification: Real-CLI probe across all configured profiles asserting verdict and findings survive interpretation

decisionEnvelope: Which model tier interprets, and whether sonnet is the floor for reading a messy transcript honestly
Whether a failed managing agent retries then falls back to the schema path, or fails the job outright
Whether the strict envelope paths are deleted or kept behind a flag as a comparison baseline
